This part is less intuitive and deserves a separate code.

The goal is to demonstrate a negative synergistic interaction between TBF and FRI on the population growth rate level.

## load packages and data

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggtext)


load("Legacy effect/data/TBFxClimate/IPM_output_final_mixed_scale_linear.Rdata") 

```

## 1. Calculate FRI effects for each Monte Carlo draw (n=1000) under Short vs Long TBF.

```{r}
rep_cols <- grep("^rep", names(all_pop_growth_rates), value = TRUE)

df <- all_pop_growth_rates %>%
  dplyr::select(FRI,s.TBF,rep_cols) %>%
  mutate(TBF=NA) 


df$TBF[1:11] <- "Short TBF"
df$TBF[12:22] <- "Long TBF"

slope_cols <- paste0("Lambda_dif", 1:10, "_", 2:11)
FRI_slopedif <- data.frame(rep = rep_cols,matrix(NA_real_,
                                                          nrow = length(rep_cols),
                                                          ncol = length(slope_cols),
                                                          dimnames = list(NULL, slope_cols)))
# i=1
# ii=1

for (i in 1: dim(FRI_slopedif)[1]) {
  rep <- FRI_slopedif$rep[i]
  for (ii in 1:10) {
    colname <- paste0("Lambda_dif", ii, "_", ii+1)
    
    slope_short <- df[df$FRI == ii+1 & df$TBF == "Short TBF", rep] - df[df$FRI == ii  & df$TBF == "Short TBF", rep]
    
    slope_long  <- df[df$FRI == ii+1 & df$TBF == "Long TBF",  rep] - df[df$FRI == ii  & df$TBF == "Long TBF",  rep]
    
    FRI_slopedif[i, colname] <- slope_long-slope_short 
  }
}
```

Now that we extracted $\Delta \lambda$ differences (Δλ*long - Δλ*\_short ) across all FRI transitions, calculate CI of Δλ

## 2. Calculate CI

```{r}
## transform to long format

FRI_slopedif_long <- FRI_slopedif %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(setdiff(names(FRI_slopedif),"rep")),
    names_to = "Δλ",
    values_to = "value"
  ) 
```

```{r}
summarized_FRI_slopedif_long <- FRI_slopedif_long %>%
  group_by(Δλ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean  = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd    = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    n     = sum(!is.na(value)),
    se    = sd / sqrt(n),
    lower = mean - 1.96 *se,
    upper = mean + 1.96 *se,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

summarized_FRI_slopedif_long$`Δλ` <- sub("Lambda_dif", "", summarized_FRI_slopedif_long$`Δλ`)


summarized_FRI_slopedif_long$`Δλ` <- sub("_", " to ", summarized_FRI_slopedif_long$`Δλ`)
```

## 3. Plotting

```{r}
summarized_FRI_slopedif_long$Δλ <- factor(
  summarized_FRI_slopedif_long$Δλ,
  levels = paste0(1:10, " to ", 2:11)
  )

ggplot(summarized_FRI_slopedif_long, aes(x = Δλ, y = mean)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), width = 0.15) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  labs(
    x = "FRI transition (years)",
    y = "ΔS <span style='font-size:9pt'>(TBF × FRI interaction effect on Δλ)</span>"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.title.y = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 14),  ## use element markdown to shrink texts in parentheses
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14)
  )
```
